events.title: Bloom Energy reported its 2025 year-end $20 billion order backlog
events.canonical_summary: At 2025 year-end, Bloom Energy reported a $20 billion order backlog, including $14 billion of future services revenue.
events.known_event_summary: On 2025-12-31, Bloom Energy reported a $20 billion backlog, including $14 billion from future services revenue.

facts.proposition: Bloom Energy's order backlog at the end of 2025 was $20 billion, including $14 billion from future services revenue.
